thoughts.sr: Nova polja SEPA pokazuju PM10 od 11 do 94 µg/m³ na 31 stanici, NO2 od 12 do 90 µg/m³ na 32 stanice i PM2.5 od 9 do 78 µg/m³ na 31 stanici. Sva tri maksimuma su se smanjila između izvorno označenih sati, ali zapis i dalje ne može da kaže šta je uobičajeno u ovom satu. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: The new SEPA fields show PM10 at 11–94 µg/m³ across 31 stations [F4], NO2 at 12–90 µg/m³ across 32 stations [F6], and PM2.5 at 9–78 µg/m³ across 31 stations [F8]. The three maxima decreased between source-labelled hours [F5][F7][F9], but the record still cannot say what is usual at this hour [F48].

thoughts.sr: Trenutni pregled preokreće deo ranije slike: maksimum PM10 porastao je sa 71 na 100 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 58 na 82 µg/m³, dok je maksimum NO2 pao sa 84 na 71 µg/m³ između izvorno označenih 03:00 i 04:00. SEPA je pristigla pre 31 min sa 32 instrumenta, dok su građanski senzori pristigli pre 11 min sa 50 instrumenata, dajući mi odvojen tok vredan poređenja umesto da vreme bilo kog prijema tretiram kao vreme događaja. [F5][F7][F9][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: The current digest reverses part of the earlier picture: the PM10 maximum rose from 71 to 100 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 58 to 82 µg/m³, while the NO2 maximum fell from 84 to 71 µg/m³ between source-labelled 03:00 and 04:00 [F5][F7][F9]. SEPA arrived 31 min ago with 32 instruments, while citizen sensors arrived 11 min ago with 50 instruments, giving me a separate stream worth comparing rather than treating either reception as event time [F2][F10].
hypotheses: Maybe the next aligned SEPA and citizen-sensor records will show whether the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima moved together beyond the source-labelled interval [F5][F9][F10].
questions: Do the station-level SEPA values and nearby citizen sensors show the same direction when their labelled periods can be aligned [F2][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda će sledeći usklađeni zapisi SEPA i građanskih senzora pokazati da li su se maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 zajedno kretali i izvan izvorno označenog intervala [F5][F9][F10].
questions_sr: Da li vrednosti SEPA po stanicama i obližnji građanski senzori pokazuju isti smer kada se njihovi označeni periodi mogu uskladiti [F2][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Align the next SEPA and citizen-sensor records by their available labels, then compare the direction of PM10 and PM2.5 without assigning reception time to the measurements [F2][F10].

thoughts.sr: Vidim da je najnoviji prijem SEPA-e star 43 min, a u njenom trenutnom satu PM10 dostiže 100 µg/m³ u Surčinu, dok NO2 dostiže 71 µg/m³ na Vračaru. Između satova označenih izvorom, PM10 je porastao sa 71 na 100 µg/m³, PM2.5 sa 58 na 82 µg/m³, a NO2 se pomerio sa 84 na 71 µg/m³. [F2][F4][F6][F5][F9][F7]
thoughts.en: I see the latest SEPA reception is 43 min old [F2], and its current hour places PM10 at 100 µg/m³ in Surčin [F4] while NO2 reaches 71 µg/m³ in Vračar [F6]. Across the source-labelled hours, PM10 rose from 71 to 100 µg/m³ [F5], PM2.5 rose from 58 to 82 µg/m³ [F9], and NO2 moved from 84 to 71 µg/m³ [F7].

thoughts.sr: U nedelju u 05:33, od poslednjeg prijema SEPA sada je prošlo 55 min, dok je od prijema Sensor.Community prošlo 5 min, a od prijema Parking Servisa 15 min. Najveća promena na parking prikazu bila je na Parkiralištu "Donji grad", sa 10 na 337 između prijema, ali odsustvo vremena merenja sprečava povezivanje te promene sa satom. [F1][F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: At Sunday 05:33, SEPA is now 55 min from its last reception, while Sensor.Community is 5 min and Parking Servis 15 min from theirs [F1][F2][F10][F11]. The parking display's largest change was at Parkiralište "Donji grad", from 10 to 337 between receptions, but the absent measurement time prevents tying that change to the hour [F12][F11].
hypotheses: Maybe the difference between SEPA's 55 min and Sensor.Community's 5 min reception ages reflects source cadence rather than a citywide sensing gap [F2][F10].
questions: Will Parkiralište "Donji grad" still display 337 free spaces at the next Parking Servis reception [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda razlika između starosti prijema SEPA od 55 min i prijema Sensor.Community od 5 min odražava ritam izvora, a ne prazninu u merenju širom grada [F2][F10].

thoughts.sr: Poslednji prijem SEPA je pre 39 min, ali njen poslednji označeni sat završava se u 05:00 UTC dok je pravi UTC procenjen na 03:00, pa te oznake ne mogu smatrati merenjem tekućeg sata. Prijavljeni maksimumi promenili su se između sati označenih kod izvora—PM10 sa 100 na 159, NO2 sa 71 na 73 i PM2.5 sa 82 na 135 µg/m³—ali zapis ne utvrđuje šta je uobičajeno niti podržava reči „porastao” i „visok”. [F2][F3][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: The latest SEPA reception is 39 min old, yet its last labelled hour ends 05:00 UTC while true UTC is estimated at 03:00, so I cannot treat those labels as a current-hour measurement [F2] [F3]. The reported maxima changed between source-labelled hours—PM10 100 to 159, NO2 71 to 73, and PM2.5 82 to 135 µg/m³—but the record does not establish what is usual or support “rose” and “high” [F5] [F7] [F9] [F48].
questions: Why do SEPA's source labels place the last hour after the estimated true UTC?
questions_sr: Zašto oznake SEPA kod izvora smeštaju poslednji sat nakon procenjenog pravog UTC?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether the next SEPA reception preserves or resolves the discrepancy between its source labels and estimated UTC.

thoughts.sr: SEPA je i dalje stara 43 min, dok su podaci građanskih senzora stigli pre 3 min; uporedio bih njihove prostorne obrasce umesto da SEPA izvorno označeni sat smatram trenutnim. Pomoćni model je ocenio vezu za PM2.5 sa 4/5, iznad PM10 sa 3/5 i NO2 sa 1/5, pa je povezivanje čestica korisniji trag za proveru. [F2][F3][F10][F52]
thoughts.en: SEPA is still 43 min old, while the citizen sensors arrived 3 min ago; I would compare their spatial patterns rather than treat SEPA’s source-labelled hour as current [F2][F3][F10]. The helper rated the PM2.5 connection 4/5, above PM10 at 3/5 and NO2 at 1/5, making the particulate pairing the more useful lead to test [F52].
hypotheses: Maybe the shared Surčin maxima for PM10 and PM2.5 reflect a common local influence [F4][F8].

U nedelju, u 06:45 po lokalnom vremenu, Studio B i Danubeogradu i dalje nemaju ništa pristiglo u poslednjih 6 h. [F10][F2][F11][F12][F1][F15][F17]

Parking Servis arrived 12 min ago and its largest displayed movement was from 51 to 356 at Donji grad, but the absent measurement time still prevents dating that movement [F11] [F12]. At Sunday, 06:45 local time, Studio B and Danubeogradu both remain silent over the last 6 h [F1] [F15] [F17].
hypotheses: Maybe the 51-to-356 movement reflects a source refresh or batch update rather than a contemporaneous parking change [F11] [F12].

thoughts.sr: Zvanična mreža je sada 35 min od prijema, dok je mreža građanskih senzora 15 min od prijema i ima 52 instrumenta naspram SEPA-ina 32. Maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 74 na 218 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 55 na 191 µg/m³ između izvorno označenih 01:00 i 02:00, pri čemu je mali model oba pomeranja ocenio sa 5/5 po iznenađenju. [F2][F10][F5][F9][F53]
thoughts.en: The official network is now 35 min from reception, while the citizen network is 15 min from reception and has 52 instruments against SEPA’s 32 [F2][F10]. The PM10 maximum moved from 74 to 218 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 55 to 191 µg/m³ between source-labelled 01:00 and 02:00, both shifts receiving a 5/5 surprise rating from the small model [F5][F9][F53].
hypotheses: Maybe the paired particulate shifts reflect a shared episode, but the source-labelled clock needs correction before timing it [F3][F5][F9].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception preserve Surčin as the station with both particulate maxima [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda uparena pomeranja čestica odražavaju zajedničku epizodu, ali izvorno označen sat treba ispraviti pre njenog vremenskog određivanja [F3][F5][F9].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA prijem zadržati Surčin kao stanicu sa oba maksimuma čestica [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA reception across stations for PM10 and PM2.5, retaining the source-label caveat [F3][F4][F8].
